description: Use when someone is planning a visit to a U.S. national park. Returns this week's official facts for a ParkReady-covered park (optionally one entrance): open/closed entrances and roads, NPS alerts and closures, an NWS forecast snapshot, seasonal hazards with what to do, and a prep checklist, each with NPS/NWS source links. Accepts a name ('Zion'), NPS code ('yose') or slug. If the park is not covered it says so and gives the official NPS conditions URL; never fill gaps with guesses.

entrance.description: Optional entrance name or slug, e.g. 'South Entrance'

park.description: Park name, NPS park code or slug, e.g. 'Yosemite' or 'grca'

name: get_park_conditions
title: National park entrance conditions this week
